rows.question: My name is John Smith and my email is learner@example.com. What is the weight of the baseline control paddle?

response.answer: The Baseline Control Paddle weighs 7.4 oz.

sources.chunk_text:
Baseline Control Paddle

A lightweight paddle for beginner control practice.

Price: $89.00 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 7.4 oz
  face_material: fiberglass
  core_material: polymer
  skill_level: beginner

Care instructions: Wipe clean and air dry. Do not machine wash.

Baseline Power Paddle

A heavier paddle for experienced players seeking power.

Price: $149.00 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 8.3 oz
  face_material: carbon fiber
  core_material: polymer
  skill_level: advanced

Care instructions: Wipe clean and air dry. Do not machine wash.

Tourna Lead Tape Roll

Tourna Lead Tape lets you customize your paddle's weight and balance point. Apply strips to the head for more power or to the handle for better control. The adhesive backing sticks firmly and can be repositioned during experimentation. Each roll provides enough tape for 4-6 paddle applications.

Price: $6.99 USD

Specifications:
  material: Adhesive-backed lead alloy
  dimensions: 1/4 in x 72 in roll
  features: ['Repositionable adhesive', 'Easy to cut with scissors', '0.25 oz per 6-inch strip']

Care instructions: Apply to a clean, dry paddle surface for best adhesion. Cover with electrical tape for a smoother feel and to prevent the lead tape from peeling during play.

HEAD Radical Tour

The HEAD Radical Tour brings tennis engineering expertise to the court. Featuring an Extreme Spin Texture (EST) face and an Optimized Tubular Construction (OTC) frame, this paddle delivers consistent power from edge to edge with a generous sweet spot suited to all-court players.

Price: $149.99 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 8.1 oz
  grip_size: 4.25 in
  face_material: Extreme Spin Texture (EST) composite
  core: Polypropylene honeycomb
  shape: standard
  length: 15.875 in
  width: 7.875 in

Care instructions: Wipe with a clean damp cloth. Inspect the edge guard periodically for cracks and replace if damaged to protect the core. Store away from moisture.

Selkirk AMPED S2

The Selkirk AMPED S2 delivers a balanced blend of power and control, making it an excellent choice for intermediate players looking to elevate their game. Its FiberFlex fiberglass face provides a responsive feel with consistent ball placement, while the X5 polypropylene honeycomb core absorbs vibration for comfortable extended play.

Price: $129.99 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 7.8 oz
  grip_size: 4.25 in
  face_material: FiberFlex fiberglass
  core: X5 polypropylene honeycomb
  shape: widebody
  length: 15.75 in
  width: 8.0 in

Care instructions: Wipe the paddle face with a damp cloth after play to remove ball residue. Avoid leaving the paddle in direct sunlight or extreme heat, as this can warp the core. Store in a paddle cover when not in use.

sources.chunk_text:
Franklin Ben Johns Signature

Designed in collaboration with pro player Ben Johns, the Franklin Signature paddle combines a MaxGrit textured surface with a polypropylene honeycomb core for exceptional spin generation and shot control. The elongated shape extends reach without adding excessive weight, ideal for singles play.

Price: $179.99 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 8.0 oz
  grip_size: 4.125 in
  face_material: MaxGrit carbon fiber
  core: Polypropylene honeycomb
  shape: elongated
  length: 16.5 in
  width: 7.375 in

Care instructions: Clean with a damp microfiber cloth. The MaxGrit surface is durable but avoid scraping against rough surfaces. Replace the grip wrap every 3-6 months depending on play frequency.

JOOLA Hyperion CFS 16

The JOOLA Hyperion CFS 16 is a premium carbon fiber paddle designed for competitive players who demand maximum spin and power. Its Carbon Friction Surface technology creates exceptional ball grip for aggressive topspin shots, while the reactive honeycomb polymer core ensures a solid, responsive feel at the net.

Price: $199.99 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 8.2 oz
  grip_size: 4.0 in
  face_material: Carbon Friction Surface (CFS)
  core: Reactive honeycomb polymer
  shape: elongated
  length: 16.5 in
  width: 7.5 in

Care instructions: Clean the carbon fiber face with a microfiber cloth and mild soap solution. Do not use abrasive cleaners. Store in the included neoprene cover to protect the face texture.

Selkirk Vanguard Power Air

The Selkirk Vanguard Power Air represents the pinnacle of paddle engineering. Featuring a proprietary air-injected polypropylene core and a carbon fiber face with QuadFlex 4-layer construction, it delivers unmatched power without sacrificing spin or control. Built for tournament-level play.

Price: $249.99 USD

Specifications:
  weight: 8.4 oz
  grip_size: 4.25 in
  face_material: QuadFlex 4-layer carbon fiber
  core: Air-injected polypropylene
  shape: elongated
  length: 16.5 in
  width: 7.375 in

Care instructions: Clean with a microfiber cloth dampened with water. Avoid chemical cleaners that may degrade the carbon fiber surface. The edge guard is replaceable — contact Selkirk for parts.

Franklin Pickleball Sling Bag

A compact sling bag designed for players who travel light. The Franklin Sling Bag holds 2 paddles and essentials like balls, a water bottle, and phone. The adjustable cross-body strap and lightweight design make it easy to grab and go for casual play sessions.

Price: $39.99 USD

Specifications:
  dimensions: 18 x 10 x 5 in
  compartments: 3
  material: Ripstop nylon
  capacity: 12L

Care instructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. The ripstop nylon is water-resistant but not waterproof — avoid leaving the bag in rain.

PBPro Portable Net System

The PBPro Portable Net System sets up regulation-height play on any flat surface in under 5 minutes. The powder-coated steel frame with center post support keeps the net taut at 34 inches center height, and the whole system packs into an included carry bag weighing just 22 lbs.

Price: $159.99 USD

Specifications:
  material: Powder-coated steel frame, polyester net
  dimensions: 22 ft wide x 36 in tall (regulation)
  features: ['Center post height adjustment', 'Weighted base plates', 'Carry bag included', '5-minute setup']

Care instructions: After outdoor use, wipe down the steel frame to prevent rust. Store the net dry to prevent mildew. Check the center post tension mechanism periodically and lubricate with WD-40 if it becomes stiff.

rows.question: Does the baseline control paddle include gps tracking?

response.answer: Based on the provided product information, the Baseline Control Paddle does not include GPS tracking. The specifications focus on its lightweight design for beginner control practice, with no mention of tracking features.
